The '''Chamber of Conclave''' was a room within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Built within the [[Sacred spire/Legends|sacred spire]], it was a meeting room of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. At regular intervals, a conclave between representatives of all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] outposts and academies throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and the High Council would occur here for the purpose of gathering information, debating on galactic issues, and the refocusing of outlying academies.<ref name="SWCL" />
